title: ZIKV NS3 Helicase Expression in Bubble Column Reactors
author: Nathan Wright
materials: Allow incubator to reach set temperature.
Flash freeze the cell pellet in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Prepare Terrific Broth Base
steps.instruction: Prepare Terrific Broth Base with trace elements (Formedium AIMTB310) and autoclave it.

steps.title: Add Media Supplements
steps.instruction: To each litre of sterilised media add 1 mL 10 % Antifoam 204, 1 mL 1000× antibiotic stock (e.g., Kanamycin 50 mg mL⁻¹) and 20 g glycerol; mix well.

steps.title: Fill BCR Bags
steps.instruction: Add 1 L of the prepared AIM TB media to each bubble‑column reactor (BCR) bag.

steps.title: Install Sparger and Set Airflow
steps.instruction: Insert sparger stones into the bottom of each BCR bag, connect them to the air‑control valves and set the airflow to 1 L min⁻¹.

steps.title: Inoculate Culture
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of starter culture per litre of main culture (i.e., per BCR bag).

steps.title: Initial Incubation at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the bags at 37 °C for approximately 4 h (typical 4‑6 h) until the culture enters exponential growth (OD₆₀₀ ≈ 3‑5). Reduce the temperature before the auto‑induction point to improve protein solubility.

steps.title: Overnight Ambient Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the bags at ambient temperature for ~16 h (overnight) until the OD₆₀₀ stabilises (ΔOD₆₀₀≈0). Cultures may heat to 25‑27 °C; if temperature‑sensitive expression is a concern, connect an external recirculating chiller to the water bath.

steps.title: Final OD600 and Sampling
steps.instruction: Take a final OD₆₀₀ reading and collect 1 mL of culture for diagnostic testing.

steps.title: Transfer Culture to Centrifuge Bottles
steps.instruction: Place each BCR bag into a large jug, make a small incision near the top, and allow the culture to drain into a 1 L centrifuge bottle. Make larger incisions toward the bottom as needed to release all liquid and sediment while avoiding splashing.

steps.title: Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the harvested culture at 4000 rcf, 4 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Sterilise Supernatant
steps.instruction: Drain the spent media and add Virkon at 1 tablet per litre to sterilise the waste.

steps.title: Weigh Wet Pellet
steps.instruction: Record the wet cell‑pellet weight in grams.

steps.title: Freeze Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Transfer the pellet to cryo‑safe sample bags, label with full tracking information, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Sample for Rapid Assay
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of culture to a microcentrifuge tube (step 8.2).

steps.title: Lyse Sample
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL lysis reagent to the 1 mL sample. If biomass is low, take a larger volume, pellet it first, then lyse.

steps.title: Incubate Lysis
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysed sample at room temperature for 2 min in a tube rotor.

steps.title: Remove Cell Debris
steps.instruction: Pellet debris in a microtube centrifuge at 16000 rpm for 2 min (temperature not required to be 4 °C for QC).

steps.title: Collect Soluble Fraction
steps.instruction: Aspirate the soluble (mixed‑protein) supernatant with a pipette.

steps.title: Bind Proteins to IMAC Beads
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL magnetic IMAC (Ni) beads to the soluble fraction.

steps.title: Incubate Binding
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5 min in a tube rotor.

steps.title: Magnetic Separation – First
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a magnetic separator stand for 1 min.

steps.title: Collect Unbound Fraction
steps.instruction: Aspirate the unbound supernatant and reserve it for SDS‑PAGE analysis.

steps.title: Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL binding buffer to the retained beads and incubate for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Magnetic Separation – Second
steps.instruction: Place the tube back in the magnetic separator stand for 1 min.

steps.title: Collect Wash Flow‑through
steps.instruction: Aspirate the wash (unbound) fraction and reserve it for SDS‑PAGE analysis.

steps.title: Elute Bound Protein
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL elution buffer to the magnetic beads and mix.

steps.title: Collect Eluted Protein
steps.instruction: Aspirate the eluted protein solution with a pipette.

steps.title: Measure Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Measure A₂₈₀ of the eluate using a spectrophotometer (e.g., NanoDrop).

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Run an SDS‑PAGE gel to assess over‑expression and overall protein quality.
